'''Wettan Garn''' was a middle-aged [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] and member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She served at [[Titan Base]] as a weapon specialist.<ref name="OSG" />
